requirements.quote: New `bin/lean/release-status.mjs`, wired in `releaseFromCli` (`bin/lean/release.mjs`): `forgedock release status [<id>] [--repo R] [--json]`. It reads only `readActive`/`readLedger` (`release-ledger.mjs`), the intake state (`intake.mjs`) and GitHub (PR, check runs, review verdict marker). With no `<id>` it reports the active release from `_active`, or `no active release`.

Status fields (design 3.3): id, wave n/m and lane, state, lease holder + heartbeat age + epoch, hold flag, intake state, cut sha, PR, CI summary, review verdict at the head sha, merge sha, deploy run/stage/attempt when recorded, next state, rollback target, auto-rollback armed. A field the ledger does not hold prints `unknown`; nothing is guessed.

`--json` emits `schema: "forgedock.release.status/v1"` and `next_actions[]`: the exact commands an agent may run now (hold, resume, cancel, rollback, ...), each with `--reason` placeholders where mutating. Every command in `next_actions` must parse under `RELEASE_USAGE`/`runControl` verbs.

`--watch` is real: `status --watch [--interval s]` re-polls and prints on change until a terminal state. `forgedock release --watch` (accepted today with no effect) delegates to the same loop; the "has no effect" text is removed from `RELEASE_USAGE` and `docs/CONFIG.md`.

`explain #N` emits `forgedock.release.explain/v1` with an ordered `trace[]` of `{step, rule, config_key, result: pass|fail|n/a, would_change}`: (a) classification evidence (files, confidence, source, who set it) from the `FORGE:CLASSIFY` record when present, else `classification: absent`; (b) every rule that evaluates today with the config key behind it (`risk.rules[i]`, `forces[i]`, `plan.skip_labels`, `classify.min_confidence`), plus a rule registry that the planner (#5559) fills; until it registers, the trace carries `planner: not installed` instead of omitting the step; (c) the lane chosen (latest typed `lane` decision from `controls.jsonl`, #5556, else the plan's lane) and what would change it (config key, label, or `release lane #N --force ...`).

`explain <PR>` prints the same trace for gate decisions: each required check and its outcome at the PR head, which check was demoted, by whom (actor), until when (expiry), reason and issue, read from the exemption records (#5556, `exemptionsSection`). Argument rule: `#N` is an issue, a bare number or PR URL is a PR, anything else is a release id.
All three paths are read-only: zero mutating GitHub calls. On an unmanaged repo (`release.managed` off) status falls back to the local `state.json` cache and labels `source: local`.
Golden-output tests (text and JSON) from ledger plus GitHub fixtures for status, `explain #N` and `explain <PR>`.
Second-host test: a fresh home directory with no `~/.forge/releases` produces byte-identical output from the same fixtures.
Fake-io test asserts zero mutating calls; every `next_actions[]` command parses.
`--watch` test with a fake clock: prints only on change and stops at a terminal state.
After the first managed AlterLab release: `release status` and `release explain` on it from a second machine match the ledger.

deliverables.change: Rework: status adds wave n/m+lane, heartbeat age (from recorded timestamps only), cut sha, CI summary, review verdict at head, merge sha, deploy run/stage/attempt, rollback target, auto-rollback armed; absent fields print `unknown`. next_actions = hold/resume/cancel/rollback/lane commands with `--reason <reason>` placeholders, each using a verb from a exported CONTROL_VERBS list and flags in RELEASE_USAGE. watchStatus prints only when rendered output changes, stops at terminal, takes intervalMs from `--interval`. explainIssue trace items become {step, rule, config_key, result pass|fail|n/a, would_change} in order: classification (FORGE:CLASSIFY issue comment: files, confidence, source, set_by; else classification: absent), plan.skip_labels, classify.min_confidence, risk.rules[i], forces[i], depends_on, release_set, planner (`planner: not installed` via an exported registerPlannerRule registry), lane (latest typed `lane` entry in controls.jsonl else recorded lane; would_change names config key/label/`release lane #N --force`). explainPr lists every check run with outcome at head plus exemption records (check, actor, expiry, reason, issue) read from controls.jsonl/exemptions; demoted checks marked. Read-only.
readActive also returns controls[] parsed from controls.jsonl (tolerant of missing/bad lines); no change to existing exports' write paths.

releaseFromCli: `release --watch` (no subcommand) delegates to the status watch loop instead of being ignored; status accepts --interval; RELEASE_USAGE lists `--interval` and contains no `has no effect` text.

Golden text+JSON for status, explain #N, explain PR; second-host (different HOME/TMPDIR) identical bytes; zero non-GET api calls; each next_actions command parses; watch fake-clock prints only on change and stops at terminal; --interval; bare `release --watch`; unknown fields; local fallback source: local; planner not installed; classification absent/present; lane from controls; exemption fields.
Release help row documents status/explain, --interval, real --watch.
